caption: The video captures a wide expanse of calm blue water filling the lower half beneath a pale sky, with a low forested shoreline across the middle distance. A single bright cumulus cloud sits in the upper right, mirrored by a soft white reflection on the water below it. Throughout, the foreground surface ripples continuously, its fine parallel wave pattern shifting and reforming over time. The cloud's reflection shimmers and gently deforms as the water moves. The sky, shoreline, and cloud keep fixed positions, so no pan or zoom is evident. This surface motion is already underway and persists to the end, with nothing entering or leaving.
relations: The foreground water surface ripples continuously, shifting and reforming its fine parallel wave pattern over time.
The cloud's reflection on the water shimmers and gently deforms as the underlying surface moves.
The sky, shoreline, and cloud remain fixed in position, with no camera pan or zoom evident.
